source_facts.fact: Partial cases may retain output data only because modified ASWING source cannot be redistributed.
Rigid NACA0012 semispan 2.95 m / chord 1 m; experimental transition strips at 0.05c.
Prose Cdf 0, Cdp .01, dCLda 6.26, limits ±1.5, 40 circulation nodes; describes original 5.96 and modified viscous-loop results. These properties differ from literal model.
Figure 11 caption identifies viscous loop and varying quadratic 2D drag improvements.
Fourier Kj circulation variables distinguished from Ij structural nodes and horseshoe mesh.
20–40 circulation variables/Fourier coefficients; structural mesh uses cosine clustering.
Explicitly distinguishes 40 structural nodes and 40 circulation variables.
Surface chord beginning at t0 mirrors to negative t; y is reflected and other zero-start distributions copied independently.
Zero values for infinity-default stiffnesses mean rigid, not zero stiffness.
Reference area/chord/span, moment/acceleration/velocity origins and section units/defaults.
Startup can auto-read xxx.set, xxx.pnt, xxx.con; these are not retained for SA-1.
NODE changes grid-node distributions; no NODE/I exact count or Fourier-count mapping is specified in this guide.
Plus adds inherited operating point; XX converges all stackpoints. This does not preserve exact nonlinear branch/restart history.
K/I Newton iteration limit; F toggles frozen zero-alpha/beta matrices versus current wind-aligned matrices; printed example starts fast T.
Fixed PG Mach or speed-derived; section Cm correction remains separate.
Pointwise at structural intervals or smaller Fourier Fourier circulation; weighted-residual constraints when K < I−1.
Lift usesrho Gamma V cross s; profile drag directions and poststall leakage term; quarter-chord moment with Xax origin.
Relative freestream vector V[cosalpha cosbeta,−sinbeta,sinalpha cosbeta] opposite aircraft velocity.
CDi and span efficiency use Trefftz forces; e = (CLi² + CYi²) / (pi AR CDi), not total CL.
Integrated aerodynamic force and moment; stability-axis CL and Cm normalized by q S and q S Cref.
Ks≈40,delta CL ≈ .05 are published approximate choices, not recovered 5.96 build settings; poststall circulation does not decrease.
The i command specifies number of structural nodes, with at least one per breakpoint; insufficient requests are automatically increased. This is not an interval count or circulation count.

Visually inspected Figure 1.13: image says 100 nodes and k = 1 / k = 19; caption says 180 nodes. Separate node and Fourier counts are clear, but numeric defaults and original SA-1 settings are not established.
Records a correction to circulation-mode defaults when a new geometry is loaded; no numeric default is stated.
Adds CY, Cl, Cn and side force to point output. No original executable hash or SA1-specific settings are supplied.
Percent invokes the command-driven constraint editor; A selects Anchored defaults and D exits with DONE. The retained driver explicitly uses these commands.
